subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Teaching Others to Spot Scams
description: Learn Teaching Others to Spot Scams in one minute.

hook.text: The person most likely to be scammed is the one who thinks it can't happen to them.

buildup.text: Sharing scam stories normalizes the conversation and removes the stigma of being a victim.

discovery.text: Families that discuss scams openly are significantly less likely to lose money to fraud.

twist.text: Young adults now lose money to scams at higher rates than seniors — nobody is immune.

climax.text: The most effective fraud prevention isn't technology — it's awareness and open conversation.

punchline.text: The best antivirus is a conversation at the dinner table.

quiz.question: Which age group now loses money to scams at the highest rate?
